items.title: Vertiv Has Guided Itself Into A Steep Second Half
items.summary: Vertiv (VRT) is up about 88% over the past year, and down nearly 14% over the past three months. The number that should worry a holder sits in the company's own guidance: organic growth of roughly 35% in the third quarter of 2026, against the 18% organic pace it just delivered. Everything about the second half of 2026 turns on that step.

items.title: Nasdaq Recovers, but Industrial Stocks Are Still Struggling
items.summary: The Nasdaq composite recently traded 0.1% lower on the day, a near-full recovery after being down 1.3% earlier. If the tech-heavy index finishes in positive territory today, it would be the biggest intraday comeback since April 7.

items.title: Unusually High Volume in Deep Out-of-the-Money Vertiv Call Options Shows Investors Bullish on VRT
items.summary: Institutional investors have traded huge volumes of out-of-the-money call options in Vertiv Holdings (VRT) that expire in almost 16 months. This is a huge bet on the growth of its AI data center business.
